business_problem: ESG and climate-reporting demands required multilevel analytics, governance, and faster access to third-party data than NatWest's on-premises systems and limited cloud culture could provide.
solution_summary: NatWest built a bank-wide ESG analytics platform on Snowflake Data Cloud to centralize climate, emissions, risk, and social-responsibility data in a reusable cloud-native pattern. The ESG team chose Snowflake because it let them prototype fast enough to prove value to skeptical stakeholders. Third-party providers such as FactSet and S&P now publish live data directly into Snowflake instead of slow transfer processes, and a cross-cloud data mesh lets business domains access governed datasets without repeated copying. NatWest also worked with Snowflake Professional Services and dbt to create the Data Guardian Framework, a configurable control layer that profiles data quality before information enters or leaves key systems. On top of this foundation, the bank delivers near-real-time analytics and applications such as Carbon Planner, which helps customers understand and reduce climate impact while meeting regulatory and internal reporting needs.

solution_components.name: Snowflake Data Cloud
solution_components.role: Centralizes ESG, climate, and third-party provider data into a governed all-cloud source of truth.

solution_components.name: dbt
solution_components.role: Helps structure and operationalize ESG data quality and transformation workflows on Snowflake.

solution_components.name: Data Guardian Framework
solution_components.role: Applies configurable profiling and quality controls before data enters or leaves critical systems.

data_flow: ESG, climate, and third-party provider data from FactSet, S&P, and internal domains lands in Snowflake, where dbt and the Data Guardian Framework enforce quality controls. Governed datasets are then consumed by bank teams and customer tools like Carbon Planner for near-real-time analytics and recommendations.
business_outcome: NatWest cut total cost of ownership and carbon footprint by about 80%, saved roughly a year on migration, got a 40-person ESG team productive in two weeks, and now serves near-real-time climate insights to internal teams and customers.
